Description
One of the most beautiful bars of gold that has ever been struck is the Year of the Horse Gold Bar by
PAMP Suisse
. Each one of these bars has intricate and ornate designs that have attracted collectors from around the world. The obverse side of the bar features a powerful and elegant horse as a symbol for both the nation of China and the gold that it covers. Above the horse’s head is the symbol for horse embedded in a tree. On the reverse side of the bar you will see the other side of the horse as it is wrapped around the tree, with the weight and purity of the gold shown.
Each one of these bars has a single ounce of .9999 pure gold in it. This has made this bar both incredibly attractive for collectors as well as investors. Collectors will value the ornamental style and the fact that the lunar calendar will not cycle to the horse for over a decade. The investors will see that there is high quality gold in each one of these bars that can be used as a means to stave off the market variances while storing money in a safe and liquid currency. This bar can work for anyone that has an interest in gold.
Year of the Horse: 1930, 1942, 1954, 1966, 1978, 1990, 2002 or 2014.
